derivation: Expectations derive from the D167 decision, ADR-0086 and the candidate source; none from observation. Executable assertions for D cases are the frozen Qa167iDeadline.cs; native expectations are the data below as evaluated by the frozen qa167i-native.mjs.

deadlineCases.expect: Recheck(clock=7750, release=10000) cutoff 8000: 250 ms remain; 7999 passes; 8000 (equality) and 8001 refuse helper-timeout with the closed ownership text; Remaining clamps at 0.

Within at/after the cutoff runs no operation; public Read entered at equality refuses helper-timeout with no marker, no validator call and no cleanup wait; a ReadHelper-shaped call after the cutoff runs no preparation and starts no child.

Audit example: 250 ms admitted (fits 200 ms minimum), 50 ms preparation, real helper free output validated while 225 ms is charged: refuses helper-timeout at 8025, nothing returned. Control 50 + 199 returns the free response.
Preparation reaching 8000 inside Within: Read refuses before native creation (no marker, no validation). Control preparation to 7999 runs the helper and returns ok with marker.

Validator moving the clock: valid at 8000 -> helper-timeout; valid at 7999 -> returned ok; invalid at 8000 -> helper-timeout (expiry precedes invalid); invalid at 7999 -> helper-invalid. One validator call each.
Read returns at 7999, caller time reaches 8000 before Within returns: helper-timeout and nothing delivered. Control delivers ok.

WorkMilliseconds 15000, CleanupMilliseconds 2000; long window retry capped at admission + 15000 (15999 passes, 16000 refuses); late admission still capped; public Start(15000) grants (14000, 15000] and is not expired.
Release 8000: cutoff 6000 (5999 passes, 6000 refuses); admission at 5800 leaves 200, at 5801 leaves 199; admission at 6000 or 7000 is expired with 0 remaining and runs no work.
Real-clock retry deadline (release 10000): free response returned, Remaining decreased (no restart), not expired; public Start(5000) identity-shaped helper returns ok.

Real-clock cutoff 600 ms; 400 ms real preparation then a helper needing about 1500 ms: helper-timeout (cleanup confirmed, not unconfirmed), helper never finished, refusal returned < 4100 ms. Premises: cutoff (500, 600], preparation ended in [400, 600).
One cutoff 600: first operation to 400 returns, 200 remain; second 250 ms operation refuses helper-timeout; 0 remain.
